title: AWS re:Invent
metaDescription: AWS re:Invent returns to Las Vegas with AWS keynotes, labs, workshops, partner expo and hands-on cloud sessions.
venue: Caesars Forum, Caesars Palace, Encore, MGM Grand, The Venetian and Wynn

overview.about: AWS re:Invent is Amazon Web Services' huge annual cloud-computing conference, held each late autumn in Las Vegas. It is the year's biggest moment for the world's largest cloud provider, packed with major service launches, keynotes and technical training for developers and enterprises.
overview.nextEvent: The next AWS re:Invent is held in Las Vegas across multiple venues. Tens of thousands of attendees follow keynote announcements of new cloud and AI services alongside hundreds of hands-on technical sessions.

airportTransfer: LAS is the practical airport for the Las Vegas Strip; most re:Invent venues are reached by taxi, rideshare or the event shuttle network.
arrivalWindow: Arrive before 30 November if you need local check-in or opening-day access.
flightTip: Pick flights around your first confirmed venue, not just the cheapest hotel, because re:Invent spreads sessions across several Strip properties.
stayAreas: Las Vegas Strip; Convention Center area
stayGuidance: The Strip is the useful base because Caesars Forum, MGM Grand, The Venetian and Wynn are all part of the re:Invent campus pattern.
bookingAdvice: Compare the official hotel block with flexible public rates; AWS notes that discounted room inventory is limited and tied to registration.
transportTip: Plan each day by venue cluster
transportDetail: Leave buffer between sessions in different hotels; even nearby Strip properties can take longer than they look on a map.
eventDayDetail: AWS re:Invent is dated 30 November 2026 – 4 December 2026; use that range when planning arrival, tickets and reminders.

@graph.name: AWS re:Invent
@graph.description: AWS re:Invent is Amazon Web Services’ flagship cloud conference, built around hands-on labs, keynotes, chalk talks and a large partner expo. The 2026 edition runs across several Las Vegas venues, including Caesars Forum, MGM Grand, The Venetian and Wynn, so planning the campus matters as much as choosing sessions. AWS says the programme includes more than 2,200 sessions and 450-plus partners, with both in-person content and selected livestreamed programming.
